traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Ericales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): leaves spiral; opposite in some Primulaceae, Polemoniaceae, Impatiens.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Ericales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): leaves spiral. DELTA: Ebenaceae, Sapotaceae, Lecythidaceae spiral. 'sometimes decussate' for opposite-leaved Lysimachia, Phlox etc. (ours).

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Ericales page (read 2026-10-16): no order statement; DELTA Ebenaceae simple. Only Polemoniaceae has many compound-leaved species.

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Ericales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): woody; basal rosettes in Primula, Sarraceniaceae and some Polemoniaceae herbs. Weighting ours.

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Ericales page, order characterisation (read 2026-10-16): woody. Annuals mainly in Polemoniaceae, Impatiens, some Primulaceae (ours).

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb, Ericales page (read 2026-10-16): Balsaminaceae strongly monosymmetric; Lecythidaceae partly. DELTA Ebenaceae flowers regular.

traits.zygomorphy.note: APweb, Ericales page (read 2026-10-16): Impatiens spurred and resupinate; DELTA Lecythidaceae: zygomorphy from a one-sided androecial hood. Neither bilabiate nor papilionaceous.

traits.hypanthium.note: DELTA: no free hypanthium in Sapotaceae; APweb Ericales page (read 2026-10-16) describes none at order level. Styracaceae and Lecythidaceae state their own.

traits.ovary_position.note: APweb, Ericales page (read 2026-10-16): no order statement; superior in most families, inferior in Vaccinioideae, Symplocaceae, much of Lecythidaceae. Fills only families without candidates.

traits.stamens.note: APweb, Ericales page (read 2026-10-16): Lecythidaceae most varied androecium. DELTA: Sapotaceae 4-15, Ebenaceae 3-28+, Lecythidaceae 40-1000. 'typical 5' is our species weighting (Primulaceae, Sapotaceae, Balsaminaceae, Polemoniaceae vs Ericaceae 10).

traits.carpels.note: DELTA: Sapotaceae usually 4-14, Ebenaceae 2-5(16), Lecythidaceae 2-6(10); Ericaceae and Primulaceae 5. APweb gives no order statement. Weighting ours.

traits.sexual_system.note: APweb, Ericales page (read 2026-10-16): no order statement; DELTA: Ebenaceae mostly dioecious, Sapotaceae and Lecythidaceae hermaphrodite.
